values.wording: Shall Ordinance No. O-26-07 proposing to change the zoning of real property located on US 68 South (170.11 acres) in Wilmington, Ohio, be approved?
values.passage_rule: A majority affirmative vote is necessary for passage.
values.yes_effect: A YES vote approves the ordinance.
values.no_effect: A NO vote rejects the ordinance.
values.scope: Physical page2, one Wilmington1-A sample style. Description and acreage identify parcel-specific rezoning, not MW threshold, citywide data-center ban, effective date or project approval. Ballot reports council adoption; signed original ordinance not independently reviewed.
